name: game-hub
description: Cobalt Game Hub: two original multiplayer 3D browser games (Voxelvale sandbox and Arcfire Arena shooter), tablet-first.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.sw.json
